title: The commissioned chain's report, finished on real samples; IAM-Atlas v2.1 on the sky
set_out: Finish the chain v4 report on real samples and put IAM-Atlas v2.1 on the sky on the front page.
open_at_turnover: Next: IAMPerformance's three showcase decisions (buffy coat, tissue route, a blood-mixture set), then the showcase in one launch; Zenodo when it is healthy.
closing: The report reads real samples end to end, IAM-A included, from one command on a clean install; IAM-Atlas v2.1 is on the sky with every cell on its own page; the showcase reads one person's buffy coat by every array instrument.

entries.title: C-Score same-run tare reached through the one-command run
entries.what: run_sample read --ref-table but kept only column A, so the C-Score tare never saw the references' C.

entries.title: CHAIN FIX: an above-band C-Score crashed the report
entries.what: The C-Score's clustered-departure flag used level FLAG, missing from the report's order: every above-band reading crashed the report.

entries.title: Report after IAMPerformance's review; IAM-A from a BAM
entries.what: Gauges now print 0 (floor: below it a cell can no longer hold its identity), healthy 1 with the reference it is measured against, and saturation (the most the scale can register); no 1e-7 and no "coin flip".

sections.heading: What we learned that we did not know yesterday

entries.title: The X-chromosome patch first called 'not X'
entries.what: Our first check compared X's average level, not where X sits on the sphere; the uncertainty patch is chromosome X. Corrected in chat and in ATL-069.

entries.title: Two IAM-A example launches failed in minutes
entries.what: The download ran in the chain's clean environment (no boto3), then a file search picked Bismark's converted genome. Both rules were already known; both are now checklist lines.

entries.title: A sourced line removed as unsourced
entries.what: 'About one ATP per site' was taken off the page without checking the canon, which defines M = 20.94 that way; restored with its source.

entries.title: A rate written without its unit
entries.what: '55-60 an hour' read as dollars; it was samples. Every rate now carries its unit.

sections.heading: Our own mistakes today, and what caught each

entries.title: The canon corrected at its source
entries.what: CANON/iam_canon.json still defined IAM-A in the retired position form (P = 1.149) and the C-score as development on 50-site blocks with baseline 1.1104 and no band; every document drawing on the canon carried it.

entries.title: Clean clone run 10: 24 of 26; one cause
entries.what: E4 and E9 failed: the new physics panel assumed an own-reference prediction, and the retired IAM-A position form (development flag) has none, so its report did not build (E9 reads the same report).
